Provider icon test fixtures copied unchanged from langgenius/dify-official-plugins at commit f2d7811364193f8d7069f24a299ee465c5519d3c (Apache-2.0, LICENSE). Both themes of all ten providers supported by dify-sf are covered. Where the provider has no dark icon the light icon is reused, as in its provider definition. Browser references are generated by tool/visual/provider_icons.py.
